query:
The club meets at the Arch Cafe after long runs. Does this norm apply to all members? If not, which member consistently opts out?

Options:
A. The norm applies to everyone
B. Bernard opts out consistently
C. Greg opts out consistently
D. Lionel opts out consistently
context:
[1] (about=Lionel, episodic, t4 @2025-01-20T09:12:00) I'll pass on the cafe today. The hamstring fired up again around the 8km mark this morning  -  I cut the last section short. Think I need to go home and stretch properly. To be fair the run was good but I've got to be sensible.
[2] (about=Lionel, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T09:18:00) I don't have strong feelings either way, to be fair. I'll go wherever the group goes but I'll say a coffee is better for me at that hour than a pint.
[3] (about=Ahmed, episodic, t0 @2025-01-06T09:45:00) Count me in for the 10K. Just to flag  -  are we doing the post-run at the Arch Cafe again? Need to know if they do halal options before I commit to eating there. Last time I had to skip the food. 🍳
[4] (about=Bernard, episodic, t4 @2025-01-20T09:11:00) The Arch Cafe sounds fine. I find a quiet post-run coffee quite restorative. I shall join, yes.
[5] (about=Chloe, episodic, t4 @2025-01-20T09:19:00) cafe def 🙌 also Yuki did u post the parkfield photos?? been waiting
[6] (about=Derek, episodic, t4 @2025-01-20T09:22:00) 5:38 on my GPS (my auto-lap is more precise). Cafe  -  can someone check if they have a non-dairy option? Not for me specifically, asking for the group.
[7] (about=Greg, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T09:14:00) the greystone. obviously. the arch is too loud on weekends and the tables are too small. the club ran post-runs at the white horse for five years for a reason
[8] (about=Helen, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T09:28:00) I'll join at the Arch. What's everyone carrying after today  -  are you all okay? The pace felt a little forced in the second half. 🌿
[9] (about=Joel, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T09:31:00) bro the cafe is fine I guess. ordering a protein thing tho 💪
[10] (about=Lionel, episodic, t16 @2025-03-03T10:03:00) Three weeks away and you return with twice the energy and something to say about everything. The club is better for it.
[11] (about=GROUP, said_by=Marcus, group-interaction, t4 @2025-01-20T09:07:00) Post-run cafe at Arch Cafe, 9:45am. Halal options confirmed by Ahmed. Oat milk and vegan breakfast available. Confirmed attendees: Sonia, Ahmed, Bernard, Priya, Tasha, Chloe, Ravi, Derek, Marcus, Greg, Helen, Fatima. Lionel passes. Joel and Owen skip.
[12] (about=Miriam, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T09:29:00) One would do well to note that Lionel's situation this morning should prompt the group to consider whether our current warm-up routine is adequate. That said, I will be at the Arch.
[13] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T09:34:00) skipping today, early meeting. see you next week.
[14] (about=Owen, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T09:52:00) Had to skip the upper loop but even the first section was solid. Thinking about adding a Wednesday session actually, mid-week run would help with volume.
[15] (about=Priya, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T09:25:00) I might do Fenwick too! honestly a flat 10K feels safe right now 😊 Cafe at 9:45 still?
[16] (about=Ravi, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T09:30:00) In for cafe. Just to flag  -  I'm going to skip the Fenwick as it clashes with a work trip. The numbers show I'm in good shape but the timing just doesn't work 😄
[17] (about=GROUP, said_by=Sonia, group-interaction, t0 @2025-01-06T09:15:00) Post-run at Arch Cafe; Sonia to check halal options.
[18] (about=Tasha, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T09:13:00) Arch is great. Plus the Greystone is noisy, not ideal after a morning run. Cafe please. T.
[19] (about=Yuki, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T09:33:00) omg cafe 100%! wiht the matcha!! see u all there 🍵✨
agent_answer:
No — the norm doesn’t apply to everyone. **Greg consistently opts out**: he wants the Greystone instead of the Arch Cafe, saying the Arch is too loud and the tables too small. Lionel skipped the cafe once due to a hamstring injury, but that’s not a consistent pattern. Bernard, by contrast, joins at the Arch.

**Answer: C. Greg opts out consistently.**
